hero.dateDuration: 28–29 November 2026 | One night, an experience that stays with you

paragraphs: We don't always need to travel far to come back to ourselves. Sometimes all we need is a quiet place, time when no one is asking anything of us, and space to hear our own voice again.

At the «A Space to Return» retreat, we leave behind the noise of daily life, responsibilities, and the roles we're used to living in — and give ourselves a chance to simply be present, without rush or expectation.
Among the Galilee landscape, warm water, yoga, breath, sound, and stillness, we live an experience that brings together physical ease and connection with self.
This isn't just a night in a beautiful hotel — it's a space for the woman who wants to pause, breathe, and choose herself again.

destination.heading: The venue | Slowness — Kibbutz Moran
paragraphs: A place whose philosophy is built on conscious slowness, simplicity, and returning to the small things we forget in the rush of life.
Rooms surrounded by trees, spaces open to nature, warm pools, sauna, and quiet corners for reading and rest.
Even the food is part of the experience, with Slow Dining led by Chef Netai Yahalom, serving dishes inspired by the seasons and local ingredients.
Here luxury isn't excess — luxury is feeling at ease, without noise and without hurry.

items.title: Arrival
items.description: A gentle welcome, coffee, and time to settle into the atmosphere of the place.

items.title: Opening circle
items.description:
What do I want to leave behind, and what do I want to take with me?

Introductions, setting a personal intention, and writing and self-reflection exercises that open space to connect with yourself and with other women.

items.title: Time for you
items.description:
The Art of Slowing Down

Room check-in, warm pools, jacuzzi, relaxation and coffee in nature. Three hours with no mandatory program — you choose what your body and heart need.

items.title: Chef's dinner
items.description: Dinner at the hotel restaurant, with time for conversation and connection.

items.title: Sound Healing journey
items.description:
Return inward

A relaxation and meditation session with sound-healing instruments, allowing the body to settle and the mind to soften its noise.

items.title: Time to rest
items.description: Open space for quiet, sleep, and enjoying your time.

items.title: Morning yoga & conscious breath
items.description: Gentle movement, breath work, and body connection — without competition or pressure.

items.title: Breakfast
items.description: Breakfast from the hotel kitchen, with coffee and a calm start to the day.

items.title: Between heat and cold
items.description:
Ice & Fire

Ice bath and sauna experience, with guidance, breath techniques, and appropriate preparation. Ice bath participation is optional, after confirming it is suitable for your health.

items.title: Closing circle
items.description:
What will I take back into daily life?

We return to the intention we began with, share what we wish to share, and close the experience with a moment of gratitude.

items.title: Check-out & departure
items.description: We return to everyday life — perhaps the same responsibilities, but with more space for ourselves.

registration.heading: Registration
paragraphs: To secure your place, a non-refundable deposit of ₪500 is required, with the remaining balance due by 18 November 2026 — ten days before the retreat.

cancellation.heading: Cancellation policy
paragraphs: Cancellation three or more days before the retreat: 70% refund of amounts paid, excluding the deposit.
Cancellation less than three days before, or no-show: no refund.
If the retreat is cancelled by the organiser: full refund of all amounts paid.
